# PerchTV 0.1.16

Nothing changes on this television. This version carries the same number as PerchTV on Samsung televisions, which changed.

## WHAT CHANGED

- Nothing on this television. PerchTV's television apps share one version number, so a change on one kind of television moves the number on all of them. This release changes the Samsung app only: when you send something to it, it now says Loading and the name of what is starting until the picture appears; holding the up key scans forward and no longer gets stuck at high speed on a long hold, it stops where it is when you let go, and a quick tap does nothing. The down key no longer scans back, because the set did not always do it; hold the left key to go back instead.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything, including pairing, casting, play/pause and stop, the skip keys (10 s back, 30 s forward, hold for two minutes a second), the connection check every 45 seconds, and the update check on every start.
